About Bricks

Built for real estate.
Built on Apple.

Our story

How it started

Bricks builds native Apple apps for real estate professionals. We create focused tools for scanning, calculating, and managing leads — designed specifically for agents, buyers, and financial professionals in the Peruvian market.

Our mission

What we work toward

We develop tools that remove friction from real estate work. Each app does one job well — no dashboards you don’t need, no accounts to create, no data to upload. Everything stays on your device.

The suite

What we offer

Three apps, one quiet suite. Each one built to do its job and get out of the way.

Bricks Scan

Capture, name, and organize every transaction document automatically. Search inside any page in seconds.

Learn more
Bricks Calc

Model deals on the spot. Estimate payments, rates, and financing scenarios during client meetings.

Learn more
Bricks Leads

Track clients and follow-ups without complicated dashboards. A clean CRM built for real estate agents on Apple.

Learn more

These apps work together to cover the day-to-day of a working real estate professional.

Principles

Our values

Transparency

Clear, honest information. No hidden fees, no confusing terms.

Accessibility

Financial tools should be available to everyone, regardless of background or expertise.

Focus

Each app does one thing. We improve based on user feedback, not feature trends.

Privacy

Data stays on your device. No accounts required. No uploads unless you choose to share.

The team

Who we are

Bricks is built by a small team of developers, designers, and real estate professionals. We combine industry knowledge with native Apple development to build tools that make a real difference in how agents work.
